name: Moshiri Kara
description: A mansion that was set up somewhere outside the Sea of Fog. No one knows who built this place, but it seems clear that it is now nothing but a den of ravenous wolves.

tabs.name: Tutelage: Nest-Bed of Ambition
tabs.description: This masterless mansion has become the haunt of monsters from the rift. Defeat them all and obtain the treasures within.
